_about: Machine-readable acceptance limits of AFE/layout/ACCEPT.md (PROPOSED until the user approves ACCEPT.md as Decision 47). Read by AFE/layout/tb/compare.py and AFE/layout/scripts/gate.py. kinds: max / min (value against the limit), range [lo, hi], absmax (|value|), dmax (|value - baseline|), dinc (value - baseline), rrange [lo, hi] (value / baseline), report (no limit). A limit may be a number or {corner: number}. nan_ok: a missing value passes. soft: a miss prints WARN and does not fail the gate. Rationale and the Decision behind every row: ACCEPT.md section 3.

g_mid_db.why: more than 0.3 dB from the baseline = the Cin : Cf1 ratio moved by more than 3 %: check the capacitor pieces

f_lo_hz.why: Decisions 1, 2: f_lo <= 0.5 Hz (nan = no corner above 1 mHz)

idd_ua.why: a layout does not change the bias current: more than 5 % means a device or extraction error

vout_v.why: mid-scale +-50 mV (62 LSB; the host accepts +-200 LSB, Decision 44c)

hf_dev_db.why: port-level stand-in for the stage-1 loop margin: 2 dB = about 8 deg (calibration in baseline/amp_loop.json); baseline 76-81 deg, Decision 12 wants >= 60 deg

noise_d8_post_uv.why: Decisions 1, 4, 8: <= 2 uV rms in 0.5-300 Hz at typical flicker, pseudo-resistor noise as ideal resistors. = baseline noise_d8 x (post / pre of noise_real). Baseline 1.668 / 1.847 / 1.540 uV

pm_deg.why: Decision 12 / 21b: stage-1 loop phase margin >= 60 deg with the real stage-2 load (baseline 79.2 / 76.4 / 81.1); nan = no anchor, then hf_dev_db of amp_ac decides

supply_gain_50hz.why: the ADC is ratiometric (0.5): |gain - 0.5| <= 0.12 keeps the board-ripple requirement of 1 mV rms (D4b; baseline 0.566-0.579)

thd_pct.why: no target; typ / ss -40 baseline 0.04-0.05 %; ff 85 C clips at the bottom, accepted by Decision 28 (baseline of this script 2.5-3.7 %)

out_max_v.why: output reaches the top of the 1.15-2.15 V range (baseline 2.149-2.167 V)

out_min_v.why: bottom of the range; ff 85 C 1.21-1.22 V accepted (Decision 28)

err_1s_mv.why: L3b item 5 / Decision 44c: 1 s after RST_AMP every output within 10 mV of 1.65 V (baseline 0.07-0.62 mV)

vout_before_v.why: a rail before the reset = the power-up latch of A4c, expected

t_fs_ms_os10m.why: one-shot pulse: C_T x threshold / mirror current; baseline 3.0 / 1.6 / 5.8 ms (A4c 3.56 / 1.90 / 6.86 with its own threshold); 3 ms clears every step at typ and ss -40, 1 ms at ff 85

t_1mv_s_os10m.why: as amp_reset, with the host's 100 ms RST_AMP at the record start

vout_v.why: with junction area the output DC level moves (baseline of this convention 1.658 / 1.652 / 1.646 V); +-150 mV keeps it inside the host's +-200 LSB check

f_lo_hz.why: any corner below 0.5 Hz passes (Decision 2); in this convention it is below 1 mHz at typ and -40 C: report

err_1s_mv.why: after RST_AMP the output is at mid-scale in both conventions (baseline of this convention 0.9-1.5 mV); 50 mV = 62 LSB

drift_mv_s_os10m.why: RISK VIEW, not a gate: with junction area the capacitor leakage sets the DC state and the output drifts by about 1 mV/s per mV of electrode offset after every reset (baseline of this convention about 10 mV/s at 10 mV); the host re-issues RST_AMP when a channel leaves +-200 LSB (ACCEPT.md section 2)

code_offset_lsb.why: a pure code shift (AC-coupled signal); F1 expects several LSB from junction and wiring capacitance (Decision 46d: L1b restates it); 15 LSB keeps the inputs of tb_adc_steps on their boundary

inl_lo_lsb.why: Decision 43c: INL <= 1 LSB beyond the offset for inputs <= 2.0 V (typ); at ff 85 C the claim ends at 1.9 V (baseline 1.57 LSB up to 2.05 V, accepted)

inl_code_lo_lsb.why: code-based INL less the quantisation: contains the code-dependent threshold accepted by Decision 43b (baseline 0.25-1.07)

top_2v15_lsb.why: top-of-range plate error accepted by Decision 43c (+2.1 typ / +4.4 ff 85); L1b reports the change; more than +1.5 LSB on top needs the ladder

alpha.why: plate attenuation: -0.02 = about 70 fF of extra capacitance on the 3.49 pF DAC top plate

first_conv_dlsb.why: Decision 43d: the host discards the first frame

step_1536_lsb.why: Decision 43b accepted -1.1 LSB (typ / ff 85): static, below the 2.3 LSB rms of amplifier noise at the ADC input

step_2048_lsb.why: Decision 43b accepted +1.3 / +1.55 LSB; with the MIM preamp capacitors F1 expects +0.8 / +1.3

step_2112_lsb.why: roll-over of the LSB array: bridge capacitor and bridge-node parasitic (Decision 40a; 0.018 LSB per fF, baseline 0.05 LSB)

settle_worst_lsb.why: DAC settled to 0.5 LSB when the comparator fires, inputs up to 2.0 V, matched corners; the mixed corner misses by 0.65-0.75 LSB pre-layout, accepted by Decision 44f

late.why: every decision inside the window of the clock chain

settle_top_lsb.why: inputs above 2.0 V: slow tail of the top-of-range error accepted by Decision 43c (baseline up to 1.45 LSB at ff -40); L1b reports the change

dt_max_lsb.why: the 0.21 ns driver-gate overlap of the gate-level timing (audit m3) must not move a transition (baseline 0.004 LSB)

t90_n8_ms.why: the host waits >= 5 s before RST_AMP (Decision 44c); baseline 3.7 / 1.0 / 3565 ms

settled_n8.why: the bias reaches its final state

vcm_v.why: ladder tap (ratio of matched ppolyf_u_1k segments): 5 mV = 6 LSB

ron_max_kohm.why: A4b: more than 133 kOhm in series breaks the 2 uV noise budget (baseline 21 / 16 / 34 kOhm)

i_off_pa.why: off leakage below 1 pA inside the rails (audit i4)

offset_lsb.why: pure code shift (Decisions 43e, 46d); same limit as adc_codes

inl_lo_lsb.why: Decision 43c: INL <= 1 LSB beyond the offset below 2.05 V; ff 85 C 1.99 LSB accepted (claim ends at 1.9 V)

amp_minus_adc_lsb.why: settling of amplifier + TGATE into the ADC within T_ACQ: <= 0.5 LSB (pre-layout 0.08 LSB without the TGATE)

inl_all_lsb.why: whole 1.15-2.15 V range: top-of-range error accepted by Decision 43c

dt_max_lsb.why: shift of a transition level by the supply: <= 0.5 LSB (Decision 40e / 43f; pre-layout <= 0.03 LSB at the last trial, 0.25 LSB by input sweep at ff -40)

dres_max_lsb.why: plate residue change at any decision instant; ff -40 C 3.6 V was AT 0.5 LSB pre-layout (an inductance item, Decision 43f): up to 0.8 is the pre-approved degradation, above it the ladder applies
ff -40: more than the pre-layout 0.5 LSB: report and state the pad inductance used

dcode_max.why: a 1 LSB code change is not a measure of the error (X2 S4: the centred inputs sit on a transition)

victim_conv_lsb.why: what the neighbour's conversions add at the victim's next samples: <= 0.5 LSB (pre-layout 0.002 LSB; the kick only matters within 5 us of a resume)

dcode_conv.why: the victim code does not change with the neighbour's conversions

floor_lsb.why: numerical floor between two separate runs, not crosstalk

err_max_mv.why: L3b item 5: every output within 10 mV of 1.65 V 1 s after the common RST_AMP

vrs_dip_mv.why: dip of the shared reset level while 8 channels reset together (audit R10 estimate 12 mV; baseline 15 mV): report

latched_before.why: 8 = every channel latched before the reset, expected (A4c)

rec_dev_mv.why: the parked amplifier input stays on vcm_in while the IPG path carries 2.9 V pp

out_dev_mv.why: the parked amplifier stays out of the rails during stimulation (baseline 0.02 mV)

rec_dev_mv_leak.why: same with 200 pA of pad leakage on E and REF

out_dev_mv_leak.why: same with 200 pA of pad leakage

final_v.why: record start 0.3 s after the stimulation: back at mid-scale
